{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check for assay_batch unit error
batch_a = df[df["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"]
batch_b = df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"]
print(f'Batch A: {batch_a.describe()}\nBatch B: {batch_b.describe()}')

# Check for sample_seq duplicates
print(f'Patient_id with multiple sample_seq: {df["patient_id"].duplicated(keep=False).sum()}')

# Check if treatment arm has both sexes
print(f'Treatment arm has both sexes: {df[df["arm"] == "treatment"]["sex"].unique()}')

# Check if severity is confounded with sex in treatment arm
print(f'Severity distribution by sex in treatment arm:\n{df[df["arm"] == "treatment"][["sex", "severity"]].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)}')"}
